description: This is a shell script used for testing Git log graph visualizations, specifically focusing on the representation of octopus merges with various configurations and visual enhancements like colors.

methods.name: test_cmp_graph
methods.description: Compares the current git log graph output with an expected output, used to verify graph rendering.

methods.name: test_cmp_colored_graph
methods.description: Compares the colored git log graph output with an expected colored output.
